question.text: A water fountain on the ground sprinkles water all around it. If the speed of water coming out of the fountain is $\mathrm{v}$, the total area around the fountain that gets wet is :

solution.text:
Max. range $=\frac{u^2}{\mathrm{~g}}$ i.e., $\frac{v^2}{\mathrm{~g}}$ (radius of circle)
$$
\text { Area occupied }=\pi\left(\frac{\mathrm{v}^2}{\mathrm{~g}}\right)^2=\frac{\pi \mathrm{v}^4}{\mathrm{~g}^2}
$$
